risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Persistent geopolitical tensions continue to disrupt the raw-material supply chain, requiring the Company to negotiate with vendors and logistics providers to mitigate supply-chain risk.
- Volatility in prices and availability of key raw materials may adversely impact demand-supply dynamics and the Company's competitive position.
- Operations require adequate working capital; the Company has no long-term borrowings but relies on a Cash Credit facility, and increased working-capital needs or delayed receivables could increase dependence on short-term borrowings and impact liquidity.
- The Company is exposed to fluctuations in interest rates on its Cash Credit facility; an increase could raise finance costs and adversely affect profitability.
- Transactions denominated in foreign currencies expose the Company to exchange-rate fluctuations affecting the cost of imported raw materials and/or export realizations.
- Dumping of Chinese camphor, emergence of new players and increased domestic capacity have created intense pricing pressure.
- Natural camphor imports from China combined with domestic capacity additions by organized manufacturers are creating supply that exceeds domestic demand.
